label: prf:categorical-laplace-exists
title: Proof of existence of the categorical Laplace transform
html:
Proof. Proof of existence of the categorical Laplace transform

The grouplike \exp_q(-s\cdot) \in G(\mathcal{H}_q) exists by (existence of \exp_q). The Markov trace \mathrm{tr}_M \colon \mathrm{End}_{\mathbf{C}}(A) \to \mathbf{1} exists by the rigid structure and Frobenius pairing. For each s, the morphism \mathcal{L}[f](s) = \mathrm{tr}_M(\exp_q(-s\cdot) \cdot f) is therefore a well-defined element of \mathrm{Hom}(\mathbf{1}, A). Functoriality in f and monoidality (intertwining \ast_q with \cdot) follow from the coproduct axiom on \exp_q.
